headline: Transfer rumors, news: Galatasaray offer Bruno Fernandes double his salary
description: Galatasaray have stepped up their pursuit of Manchester United midfielder Bruno Fernandes. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Wayne Rooney on Marcus Rashford at Man United: 'Has he got the hunger?'
description: Marcus Rashford must alter his body language and show that he has the "hunger" to play for Manchester United, Wayne Rooney has said.

headline: 2026 FC 100: Kane, Yamal, Messi among best men's soccer players
description: Before the 2026-27 season kicks off across Europe this weekend, it's time to rank the top 100 players in the world of men's soccer, including those who starred at the World Cup this summer. Welcome to the FC 100.

headline: Pep Guardiola mentions divorce in furious rant at Man City players: 'We lost the passion'
description: Pep Guardiola revealed he and his wife "lost the passion" in their marriage as he opened up about personal struggles during his final years at Manchester City.

headline: Can Arsenal avoid breaking Rice in their Premier League title defense?
description: Declan Rice's durability has long been praised, but after a grueling season for club and country, can he do it all again for Arsenal's title defense?

headline: EA Sports FC 27 player ratings revealed: Erling Haaland, Kylian Mbappé top list ahead of Rodri, Harry Kane
description: EA Sports have revealed the 27 top-rated men's and women's players ahead the much-anticipated release of FC 27.
